dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Work? Why, I'm doing something far more important than work!

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Those who always work and work will find themselves little different from clockwork machines. It is only through constant questioning and asking that we can forge a new path!

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Our history and present are all proof of this.

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: If you do not mind treating me to a cup of coffee, we can continue this line of conversation.
